say:1:1460453001:1.text: So that relationship... it was all in my head, just like the pain I felt...
say:1:1460453001:1.source_cn: 原来和我的心碎一样，那段恋爱也是幻想啊……

say:2:1460453002:1.text: Well... maybe not all in your head. You and Nia had something. I mean, from a certain angle, you two kinda worked...
say:2:1460453002:1.source_cn: 倒也不能完全说是幻想，至少你和妮艾，该怎么说呢，这么看...

choice_prompt:3:1460453002.text: Well... maybe not all in your head. You and Nia had something. I mean, from a certain angle, you two kinda worked...
choice_prompt:3:1460453002.source_cn: 倒也不能完全说是幻想，至少你和妮艾，该怎么说呢，这么看还挺合拍的……

say:4:1460453003:1.text: What do you expect? I've never been in love!
say:4:1460453003:1.source_cn: 我有什么办法！我又没谈过恋爱！
say:4:1460453003:1.male: What do you expect? I've never been in love!
say:4:1460453003:1.female: What do you expect? I've never been in love!

say:5:1460453004:1.text: Uh... Brendan? If you'd like, I could arrange a meeting with Nia.
say:5:1460453004:1.source_cn: 呃，宾塔，你要是有需要的话，我倒是可以帮你邀请妮艾见个面。

say:6:1460453005:1.text: Really? I... I might actually see her again?

say:7:1460453006:1.text: Of course! Neither of you did anything wrong. You just got a little carried away, that's all.
say:7:1460453006:1.source_cn: 有什么不能的！你们彼此都没做错什么事，只是从幻想中清醒而已。

say:8:1460453007:1.text: Actually, I think this might be a chance for you two to really get to know each other, and maybe fall in love for real this time.
say:8:1460453007:1.source_cn: 我倒是觉得，你们这样反而有了能够重新认识彼此，谈一场真...

say:9:1460453008:1.text: You know, I was looking at <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s recipe earlier, and it got me thinking.
say:9:1460453008:1.male: You know, I was looking at <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s recipe earlier, and it got me thinking.
say:9:1460453008:1.female: You know, I was looking at <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s recipe earlier, and it got me thinking.

say:10:1460453009:1.text: Compared to all those rosy dreams and dramatic fantasies, reality can be a little boring.
say:10:1460453009:1.source_cn: 和美丽的情感与浪漫的幻想比，现实或许不值一提。

say:11:1460453010:1.text: But it's only when you plant your feet in reality that genuine feelings have a chance to grow.
say:11:1460453010:1.source_cn: 但唯有先立足于现实，那些美妙的情感才能有机会诞生并扩大。

say:12:1460453011:1.text: Take you and Nia. Sure, things got a little delusional later on, but it all started with something real: you saving her like a hero.
say:12:1460453011:1.source_cn: 就像你和妮艾的相识，尽管后续开始各自沉浸在幻梦中，但最...

say:13:1460453012:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s medicine wasn't here to crush your dreams. It's here to give you the courage to start over. That's how I see it.
say:13:1460453012:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s medicine wasn't here to crush your dreams. It's here to give you the courage to start over. That's how I see it.
say:13:1460453012:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s medicine wasn't here to crush your dreams. It's here to give you the courage to start over. That's how I see it.

say:14:1460453013:1.text: Yeah, I get it now. Thanks, Xera. And thank you, Magister.
say:14:1460453013:1.source_cn: 嗯，我明白了，谢谢你，席蕾，也谢谢你，魔法师大人。
say:14:1460453013:1.male: Yeah, I get it now. Thanks, Xera. And thank you, Magister.
say:14:1460453013:1.female: Yeah, I get it now. Thanks, Xera. And thank you, Magister.

say:15:1460453014:1.text: I think I finally have the courage to confront the past... but I'm not quite ready to start over with Nia.
say:15:1460453014:1.source_cn: 现在的我，应该有了回顾过往错误的勇气……但，还没有到再...

say:16:1460453015:1.text: I'll take a bit more time to get myself together, and when I'm ready, I'll tell her how I really feel!
say:16:1460453015:1.source_cn: 我会再调整一阵子，到时，我会去找妮艾告白！

say:18:1460453016:1.text: Thanks for everything. Captain Indris, I'm ready to return to duty!
say:18:1460453016:1.source_cn: 这段时间麻烦您了，因度厄队长，我申请归队，重新工作！

say:19:1460453017:1.text: Wasn't much trouble, really. Though the crying and moping did get a bit loud. I'll admit, I didn't understand most of it.
say:19:1460453017:1.source_cn: 倒谈不上麻烦，就是每天哭哭啼啼得有点吵，我也有点难以理解。

say:21:1460453018:1.text: But hey, if you've stopped crying, then we're good. Just be more careful with your next relationship, alright?
say:21:1460453018:1.source_cn: 算了，既然已经不哭不闹了就没事了，下次恋爱多注意。

say:23:1460453019:1.text: Say... you think there's a potion that could fix Indris' stone-cold heart? Guy never flinches at anything.
say:23:1460453019:1.source_cn: 我说，因度厄这种在大家都振奋感动的时候永远不为所动的铁...

choice_prompt:24:1460453019.text: Say... you think there's a potion that could fix Indris' stone-cold heart? Guy never flinches at anything.
choice_prompt:24:1460453019.source_cn: 我说，因度厄这种在大家都振奋感动的时候永远不为所动的铁石心肠，有没有药能治啊。

say:25:1460453020:1.text: What a shame. If there was, I bet all of Sal'thorin would line up just to see Indris tear up...
say:25:1460453020:1.source_cn: 真可惜，要是能有这种药，给因度厄灌一瓶，恐怕整个萨洛克...
say:25:1460453020:1.male: What a shame. If there was, I bet all of Sal'thorin would line up just to see Indris tear up...
say:25:1460453020:1.female: What a shame. If there was, I bet all of Sal'thorin would line up just to see Indris tear up...

choice:3:0:1.text: Wow, you're terrible at comforting people.
choice:3:0:1.male: Wow, you're terrible at comforting people.
choice:3:0:1.female: Wow, you're terrible at comforting people.
